info.name: TeamCity REST Agent Pools Builds API
info.description:
The TeamCity REST API provides programmatic access to JetBrains TeamCity continuous integration and deployment server. It allows you to manage projects, build configurations, builds, agents, users, VCS roots, changes, tests, and other TeamCity resources.

Contact Support:
 Name: JetBrains
 Email: teamcity-support@jetbrains.com
